question: How many orders are in the database?
goldSql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM orders

question: How many orders were delivered?
goldSql: SELECT count(*) AS delivered_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'

question: How many orders were canceled?
goldSql: SELECT count(*) AS canceled_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'canceled'

question: How many sellers are there?
goldSql: SELECT count(*) AS sellers FROM sellers

question: What is the average review score?
goldSql: SELECT round(avg(review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score FROM order_reviews

question: How many products are in the catalog?
goldSql: SELECT count(*) AS products FROM products

question: How many orders were placed in 2017?
goldSql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01'

question: How many payments are there for each payment type?
goldSql: SELECT payment_type, count(*) AS payments FROM order_payments GROUP BY payment_type

question: How many delivered orders arrived after the estimated delivery date?
goldSql: SELECT count(*) AS late_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date

question: How many customer records are in the state SP?
goldSql: SELECT count(*) AS customers FROM customers WHERE customer_state = 'SP'

question: What is the total freight value across all order items?
goldSql: SELECT round(sum(freight_value), 2) AS total_freight FROM order_items

question: How many reviews gave a score of 5?
goldSql: SELECT count(*) AS five_star_reviews FROM order_reviews WHERE review_score = 5

question: How many sellers are in each state?
goldSql: SELECT seller_state, count(*) AS sellers FROM sellers GROUP BY seller_state

question: How many orders are there in each order status?
goldSql: SELECT order_status, count(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY order_status

question: What is the highest single item price?
goldSql: SELECT max(price) AS max_price FROM order_items

question: What is the average number of payment installments?
goldSql: SELECT round(avg(payment_installments), 2) AS avg_installments FROM order_payments

question: Who is our best customer?
trueIntent: Rank customers (by customer_unique_id) by the total amount they paid, excluding canceled and unavailable orders
goldSql: SELECT c.customer_unique_id, round(sum(p.payment_value), 2) AS total_paid FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id ORDER BY total_paid DESC, c.customer_unique_id LIMIT 1

question: Show the top 5 sellers
trueIntent: Rank sellers by revenue: the sum of item prices, excluding canceled and unavailable orders
goldSql: SELECT i.seller_id, round(sum(i.price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY i.seller_id ORDER BY revenue DESC, i.seller_id LIMIT 5

question: What is our best selling product category?
trueIntent: The category with the most items sold (count of order items), excluding canceled and unavailable orders
goldSql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category, count(*) AS items_sold FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english ORDER BY items_sold DESC, category LIMIT 1

question: What is the revenue by product category?
trueIntent: Revenue is the sum of item prices, excluding freight and excluding canceled and unavailable orders
goldSql: SELECT t.product_category_name_english AS category, round(sum(i.price), 2) AS revenue FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN product_category_name_translation t ON t.product_category_name = p.product_category_name WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY t.product_category_name_english

question: What was our total revenue?
trueIntent: Total revenue is the sum of payment values, excluding canceled and unavailable orders
goldSql: SELECT round(sum(p.payment_value), 2) AS revenue FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')

question: Which state is our biggest market?
trueIntent: The customer state with the most orders
goldSql: SELECT c.customer_state, count(*) AS orders FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_state ORDER BY orders DESC, c.customer_state LIMIT 1

question: How many orders did we get last month?
trueIntent: The previous full calendar month before the as-of date
goldSql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '{{prev_month_start}}' AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '{{month_start}}'

question: What was the revenue last quarter?
trueIntent: Payments for the previous full calendar quarter before the as-of date, excluding canceled and unavailable orders
goldSql: SELECT round(sum(p.payment_value), 2) AS revenue FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '{{prev_quarter_start}}' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '{{quarter_start}}'

question: How many orders have we had this year?
trueIntent: From January 1 of the as-of year up to and including the as-of date
goldSql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '{{year_start}}' AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '{{tomorrow}}'

question: How many orders did we get last year?
trueIntent: The previous full calendar year before the as-of date
goldSql: SELECT count(*) AS orders FROM orders WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '{{prev_year_start}}' AND order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '{{year_start}}'

question: How many customers do we have?
trueIntent: Distinct people: count of distinct customer_unique_id
goldSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS customers FROM customers

question: What is the average order value?
trueIntent: Total payments divided by the number of distinct orders, excluding canceled and unavailable orders
goldSql: SELECT round(sum(p.payment_value) / count(DISTINCT p.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')

question: How many active sellers do we have?
trueIntent: Sellers that sold at least one item (distinct seller_id in order_items)
goldSql: SELECT count(DISTINCT seller_id) AS active_sellers FROM order_items

question: What is the average delivery time?
trueIntent: Average number of days from purchase to delivery to the customer, delivered orders only
goldSql: SELECT round(avg(extract(epoch FROM (order_delivered_customer_date - order_purchase_timestamp)) / 86400.0), 2) AS avg_delivery_days FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL

question: What is the typical order size?
trueIntent: The median total payment value per order, excluding canceled and unavailable orders
goldSql: SELECT round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.total)::numeric, 2) AS median_order_value FROM (SELECT p.order_id, sum(p.payment_value) AS total FROM order_payments p JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY p.order_id) t

question: How many orders were completed?
trueIntent: Completed means delivered
goldSql: SELECT count(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered'

question: Which products sell the most?
trueIntent: Top 10 products by number of units sold (count of order items), excluding canceled and unavailable orders
goldSql: SELECT i.product_id, count(*) AS units FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY i.product_id ORDER BY units DESC, i.product_id LIMIT 10

question: How many orders were late?
trueIntent: Delivered orders that arrived after the estimated delivery date
goldSql: SELECT count(*) AS late_orders FROM orders WHERE order_status = 'delivered' AND order_delivered_customer_date > order_estimated_delivery_date

question: What is the average freight per order?
trueIntent: Total freight divided by the number of distinct orders (per order, not per item)
goldSql: SELECT round(sum(freight_value) / count(DISTINCT order_id), 2) AS avg_freight_per_order FROM order_items

question: What is the average review score by seller?
trueIntent: Each seller's average review score over the orders they fulfilled, counting each order's review once per seller
goldSql: SELECT s.seller_id, round(avg(x.review_score), 2) AS avg_review_score FROM (SELECT DISTINCT i.seller_id, r.review_id, r.review_score FROM order_items i JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = i.order_id) x JOIN sellers s ON s.seller_id = x.seller_id GROUP BY s.seller_id
